declaredStatus.claim: Source roots are lightweight, URL imports are rejected locally against exact scopes, successful lazy modules are reused and failed imports permit retry.

checks.question: Are metadata, local parsing and implementation exports owned by the source package and consumed through public interfaces?
checks.detail: Only root and /runtime are public; internal dependencies use workspace:*. Module source.bilibili, provider bilibili and local contribution provider remain distinct. Target source/plugin-center files have no working-tree modifications.

checks.question: Does metadata avoid eager runtime imports and does the lazy adapter share successful/pending work and retry rejected imports?
checks.detail: Transpiled static root graph: 23 files, zero external runtime imports, no protocol/runtime/signing, Vue or codec dependency. Existing 5 lazy tests plus the Bilibili-specific injected-loader probe establish demand loading, shared pending/successful loads and rejected-load retry. Production application loader composition remains B11/B12.

checks.question: Does the preflight reject undeclared URLs locally while preserving bounded demand, cancellation and close behavior?
checks.detail: B10-B01: six URL cases outside the declared origins return a lazy listing instead of throwing. Separately, six supported URL classes and five malformed/unsupported inputs pass; iterator creation performs zero loads, first next loads once, early return consumes one page and closes once, and cancellation during a pending load prevents source-listing creation. These observations use a deterministic delegated iterator, not Bilibili API pagination.

checks.question: Do inspected local parser failures use shared semantic errors and preserve parse causes without introducing storage or credentials?
checks.detail: Malformed URL errors use MusicSourceError invalid-input with the original cause; unsupported host/path errors use unsupported-url. The selected root/preflight/lazy slice adds no persistence or credential authority. Runtime HTTP failures and cross-layer AppErrorState conversion are deferred.

checks.question: Do owner tests establish the descriptor/preflight contract and are evidence levels reported accurately?
checks.detail: The 6 existing source tests and 5 lazy-adapter tests pass, but source-root/URL exact-origin behavior has no existing regression coverage. Temporary probe: 16 passed, 6 failed for B10-B01. Probe source/logs are local and the package probe is removed. No contract/captureDate or maintained architecture content was changed.

findings.title: URL preflight accepts origins excluded by the descriptor
findings.trigger: Import http://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xx411c7mD/ or ftp://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xx411c7mD/ or https://www.bilibili.com:444/video/BV1xx411c7mD/; equivalent space.bilibili.com upload URLs reproduce the same issue.
findings.cause: The source parser compares URL.hostname only. Neither its exported parser nor LazyMusicSourcePlugin.importFromUrl enforces URL.origin against descriptor.importUrlScopes.
findings.effect: Public plugin validation succeeds and creates a listing carrying a URL outside the declared import scope. The workbench final preflight calls this validator; UI immediate feedback applies stricter exact-origin rules, so the two layers disagree. This is a local contract/validation defect; no arbitrary target transport, credential leak or real UI/network exploit is asserted.

reproduction.expected: All six inputs outside the declared exact origins throw unsupported-url before a listing or runtime load.
reproduction.observed: All six return normally from lazy importFromUrl; the six toThrow assertions fail.

findings.suggestedNextAction: In a separate fix, enforce exact origin/path scope in source-owned local preflight before target parsing. Add permanent tests for both hosts, HTTP/FTP/non-default ports, valid HTTPS/default 443 and all six supported URL classes. Preserve the current dependency direction and re-run source plus direct lazy/consumer tests.
